# Grupo Arcondec S.A. de C.V.

> Empresa mexicana de ingeniería eléctrica y construcción de centros de datos. Fundada en 1991 en Monterrey, Nuevo León. Diseña y ejecuta infraestructura eléctrica industrial y data centers llave en mano, desde la etapa conceptual hasta la entrega final.

Opera en toda la República Mexicana. Sitio bilingüe: español en la raíz, inglés bajo /en/.

## Datos de contacto

- Razón social: Grupo Arcondec S.A. de C.V.
- Fundación: 1991

- Sitio: https://arcondec.mx/

## Servicios

### Turnkey construction

- [Data Center Construction](https://arcondec.mx/en/services/data-center-construction.html): Turnkey data center construction: UPS, emergency power plants, fire protection, precision cooling and BMS/DCIM monitoring for 24/7 operation
- [Data Center Operations and Maintenance](https://arcondec.mx/en/services/data-center-operations-maintenance.html): Data center operations and maintenance in Mexico: 24/7 emergency support, preventive and corrective maintenance, diagnostics and critical infrastructure upgrades
- [Civil Works](https://arcondec.mx/en/services/civil-engineering-data-center.html): Civil works for data centers: foundations, raised floors in white areas, aisle containment and industrial finishes per TIA-942, NEC and NFPA

### Electrical engineering

- [Electrical Solutions](https://arcondec.mx/en/services/electrical-solutions.html): Electrical solutions for data centers and industry: engineering, UPS, backup power, distribution, protection and grounding for your critical infrastructure
- [Direct Current](https://arcondec.mx/en/services/direct-current-solutions.html): Direct current solutions: engineering, DC power plants, battery banks, distribution cabinets, testing and maintenance services for critical infrastructure
- [Alternating Current](https://arcondec.mx/en/services/alternating-current-solutions.html): Alternating current systems: distribution switchboards, automatic transfer, power feeders and emergency generator backup for critical infrastructure
- [Grounding Design](https://arcondec.mx/en/services/grounding-system-design.html): Design and construction of grounding systems: ground grid, electrodes, exothermic welding, master bars, surge suppression and lightning protection

## Artículos técnicos

- [Critical power in data centers](https://arcondec.mx/en/blog/energia-critica-data-centers-ia.html): The electrical supply that mission-critical systems cannot do without: UPS, emergency plants, battery banks and high-reliability distribution
- [400 volt direct current power systems](https://arcondec.mx/en/blog/400v-dc-transformacion-centros-de-datos.html): 400 V DC distribution powers IT equipment directly, cutting conversion losses and improving overall system efficiency
- [The direct current powering leaders in critical infrastructure](https://arcondec.mx/en/blog/corriente-directa-infraestructura-critica.html): Most equipment already runs internally on DC: keeping power in that format reduces losses, conversions and points of failure
- [Keys to data center critical infrastructure](https://arcondec.mx/en/blog/claves-de-infraestructura-critica-de-un-centro-de-datos.html): The subsystems that determine a data center's real availability and how they work together
- [Electrical engineering is revolutionizing data centers](https://arcondec.mx/en/blog/ingenieria-electrica-ai-hpc.html): AI and HPC drive up power density per rack, forcing a redesign of electrical infrastructure
- [Grounding and lightning protection systems in data centers](https://arcondec.mx/en/blog/sistemas-tierras-fisicas-pararrayos.html): Protection against atmospheric discharges and potential reference in mission-critical facilities
- [Why cable management can save your data center operation](https://arcondec.mx/en/blog/peinado-de-cables-data-center.html): Cable order as a factor of maintainability, thermal dissipation and operational safety
- [Free-standing and distribution panel installation](https://arcondec.mx/en/blog/instalacion-tableros-auto-soportados-y-distribucion.html): Assembly, coordination and testing criteria for medium and low voltage panels
- [How to ensure precision when implementing a data center](https://arcondec.mx/en/blog/implementacion-centro-de-datos-precisa.html): From conceptual design to documented commissioning, with no rework or partial deliveries
- [Electrical modernization: going digital without interrupting operations](https://arcondec.mx/en/blog/modernizacion-electrica-mexico-tecnologia-digital.html): How to replace obsolete equipment and digitalize infrastructure while maintaining continuity
- [5 trends transforming data centers](https://arcondec.mx/en/blog/tendencias-infraestructura-electrica.html): Efficiency, redundancy and smart monitoring are becoming the industry standard
- [Electrical engineering that backs you up](https://arcondec.mx/en/blog/ingenieria-electrica-que-respalda.html): Infrastructure designed to sustain today's operation and enable future growth
